A Cardano data-node built in Rust

Usage: dolos [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init       Initialize the node configuration
  daemon     Run the node in all its glory
  sync       Sync from the upstream peer, and inspect, recover or roll back the WAL
  serve      Just serve data through apis
  data       Commands to interact with data
  config     Commands over the configuration file
  cache      Fill, clear, inspect and check the cache, with the node stopped
  service    Install the node as an OS service, or uninstall it
  bootstrap  Fill the node's stores from a Stelae snapshot, Mithril or a local ImmutableDB
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version
